title: Figure 8: cosmic microwave background dipole as universal motion reference frame
description: Oval all-sky projection of the cosmic microwave background in blue, yellow and red showing the dipole anisotropy, with a purple arrow indicating direction of motion. Captioned "Figure 8. Cosmic Microwaves as Universal Motion Reference Frame. [Credit: NASA]." It illustrates a section titled "Absolute Velocity – Universal Speedometer" on using CMB Doppler shifts for deep-space navigation.
